hero.title: Tirthesh Patil
hero.subtitle: Technical Product Manager with 2+ years of experience building and scaling fintech platforms across payments, AI, and data systems at Jio Financial Services. I own high-throughput systems handling 180K+ daily transactions and AI platforms serving 65K+ daily prompts.

about.lead_html: I bridge the gap between business priorities, user needs, and technical execution so teams can move from ambiguity to launch with confidence.

cards.title: What I Do
cards.description: I lead products from opportunity discovery and requirements shaping through development, launch, and iteration, keeping business goals and delivery realities aligned.

cards.title: How I Work
cards.description: I simplify messy problem spaces, define what matters, and help cross-functional teams make decisions quickly without losing sight of customer value.

cards.title: Where I Add Value
cards.description: Especially effective in fast-moving teams that need structured product thinking, stakeholder alignment, and someone who can translate between business and engineering.

projects.title: JFS SuperApp • Little Nest
bullets: Prioritized high-impact product initiatives across payments, AI, and marketplace verticals, balancing regulatory constraints, engineering bandwidth, and revenue goals.

Owned and scaled the UPI payments vertical — drove NPCI compliance certification, multi-bank API integration, and real-time monitoring → scaled volume to 180K average daily transactions at 99%+ uptime with 85%+ successful payment processing.

Defined the Consent Management compliance vertical — authored RBI-compliant AA data-sharing specifications and drove fintech vendor integration → delivered consolidated financial views to thousands of users monthly.

Drove the analytics platform implementation (Google Analytics + internal dashboards) — defined KPI frameworks tracking transaction volume, adoption, and drop-off rates → drove double-digit improvements in key engagement metrics.

Led key product initiatives for the AI-powered financial marketplace (FDs, loans, credit cards, gold) — defined product requirements and led third-party lender API integration → generated ~20% cross-sell revenue uplift post-launch.

projects.title: Government Engagements • Asset Management System • AI Chatbot Solutions
bullets: Scaled execution across a 60+ member cross-functional team spanning QA and operations — facilitated agile ceremonies and streamlined workflows → drove a ~50% improvement in team velocity across concurrent product tracks.
Delivered the RAG-based multilingual AI chatbot for a government initiative — led requirement documentation reviews and coordinated QA cycles → scaled product to 10K DAU across 12 languages.

Improved product delivery efficiency through backlog refinement and sprint planning across multiple enterprise tracks — improved requirement clarity and feasibility → reduced development rework by ~20% while keeping delivery tightly aligned to business goals.

projects.title: Frontend Web Development
bullets: Leveraged MERN stack expertise to improve technical feasibility discussions and reduce engineering iteration cycles — collaborated directly with clients to translate requirements → shipped cross-browser-compatible product features.
